items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the tax assessment
items.quote: Wer diesen Bescheid für fehlerhaft hält, kann dagegen innerhalb eines Monats Einspruch erheben.
items.computation: Letter dated 19.11.2026, 'zur Post gegeben' (dispatched) on 20.11.2026 as stated ('Abgesandt am 20.11.2026'). Under the current version of § 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO, a letter sent by ordinary mail is deemed delivered (Bekanntgabe) on the 4th day after the day it was handed to the post: 20.11 + 4 days = 24.11.2026 (Tuesday) - not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, so the fiction stands. The one-month Einspruchsfrist (§ 355 Abs. 1 AO) begins the day after Bekanntgabe (§ 108 Abs. 1 AO i.V.m. § 187 Abs. 1 BGB), i.e. 25.11.2026, and ends, per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the Bekanntgabe day: 24.12.2026 (Thursday). 24 December is not a statutory public holiday in Bremen (only 25./26.12 are), so the deadline is not shifted.
